race.comment: Keen to start Orr/Zipping day off with the lightly raced ICHNUSA (12) who looks beautifully placed up to 2400m third up. He'd shown plenty of staying ability earlier this year, winning in city grade over 2000m at his second start and two runs back this time in have been good from tough spots. Rattled home on Cup day to grab fourth and finds an ideal race third up. MR O'REILLY (11) did beat ICHNUSA home at Flemington last time when second to the progressive Yauson. Had every chance on speed there but the trip won't worry him and he gets map favours again. FIOROWNGOOD (8) is flying with four straight wins, this is tougher but he warrants respect. JOHNICH (3) struggled in the key lead up but is better than that.
